caveats: Google Maps only served a 'limited view' to this browser throughout, which shows the star rating and category but not the review count. Review counts are therefore 'unknown' for every business except where a site itself claimed a number (Anchor claims 15,107 aggregated).

Three sites in this batch (Iovino's, Grande, Anchor) and one profile page share a horse emoji prefixed to the browser title, which suggests a common website builder or agency template (inference) - not verified.
Dave & Son is listed by the batch as East Brunswick but the site positions itself in Old Bridge (PO Box 787, Old Bridge NJ 08857) while serving East Brunswick too. Treated as operating and in-area.

Absence of a Google Business Profile (Grande, Undercutters) and absence of a listing for a specific phone (Dave & Son) are negative findings from Maps name and phone searches, not proof the listing does not exist under some other name.
Scores are relative to each other within this batch of small landscaping/tree/pest businesses, not to the industry overall.
No contact forms, bookings or quote flows were submitted; all form structure was read from the rendered DOM only.
